_comment: Template: Generate CIM instance data from a CimPal Excel template.
_how_to_use: Copy to your working directory. Replace REPLACE_WITH_PATH values. Run: java -jar CimPal-CLI.jar gen-instances --config this-file.json
_when_to_use: Use this to generate synthetic CGMES instance data from a spreadsheet template. Useful for creating test fixtures for SHACL shape development.
_note_templateXlsx: CimPal Advanced template (.xlsx). Must have: a 'Config' sheet defining namespaces and class names, and one sheet per class (e.g. 'ACLineSegment', 'VoltageLevel'). Generate a blank template from an RDFS profile using the GUI's Generate Instance Data tab.
_note_output: Where to write the generated RDF/XML file. Extension should be .xml. The filename stem becomes the model name embedded in the md:FullModel header.
_note_xmlBase: Base URI for the generated model. Must match the CGMES version of the template. CGMES 3.0/CIM17: http://iec.ch/TC57/CIM100. CGMES 2.4/CIM16: http://iec.ch/TC57/2013/CIM-schema-cim16.
_note_stripPrefixes: true removes unused namespace prefix declarations from the output. Produces smaller files; safe to use when the output will be parsed by CimPal or standard tools.
_note_exportExtensions: true includes columns marked IsExtension=Yes in the template. Leave false for standard CGMES output.
